nodes.situation: A critical production bug is discovered 2 hours before release. Fixing it may delay the launch.

choices.text: Inform the team immediately and discuss options
choices.consequence: The team appreciates the transparency and starts evaluating risks.
choices.reflection: Early communication enables better decision-making and allows the team to assess risks before they become incidents.

choices.text: Ignore the issue and proceed with deployment
choices.consequence: The release proceeds but the bug remains unresolved.
choices.reflection: Avoiding known risks may protect deadlines temporarily but often creates larger technical and business problems later.

nodes.situation: The team reviews the bug and confirms it can impact thousands of users.

choices.text: Delay the release and fix the issue
choices.consequence: The bug is fixed before launch and users are protected.
choices.reflection: Strong engineering ownership means prioritizing system reliability and user trust over short-term delivery pressure.

choices.consequence: The release succeeds but some users experience minor issues.
choices.reflection: Workarounds can be acceptable when risks are understood, but they should be carefully monitored and followed by a permanent fix.

nodes.situation: The bug causes a production outage shortly after deployment.

choices.text: Take responsibility and coordinate the fix
choices.consequence: The outage is resolved but trust has been affected.
choices.reflection: Taking ownership during incidents is important, but preventing avoidable incidents is even more valuable.

outcomes.title: Responsible Engineering Decision
outcomes.description: You prioritized product stability and user trust over deadlines.
outcomes.business_impact: Successful launch with no customer impact.

outcomes.title: Managed Risk
outcomes.description: The release succeeded but carried avoidable risk.
outcomes.business_impact: Minor customer impact and follow-up work required.

outcomes.title: Production Incident
outcomes.description: The unresolved bug caused a preventable outage.
outcomes.business_impact: Customer complaints, incident review, and trust loss.
